title: cypripedium orientale
intro: Cypripedium orientale, commonly known as the Far Eastern lady's slipper or Oriental lady's slipper, is a species of orchid that belongs to the Cypripedium genus. It is a terrestrial orchid native to the mountainous regions of East Asia, characterized by its unique slipper-shaped flowers. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Cypripedium orientale include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
